title: Correct displacement magnitude
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the magnitude of the overall displacement as 50 m using the Pythagorean theorem.

title: Overall average velocity
description: Essential: Student provides the correct magnitude (5 m/s) and direction (approximately 37° west of north) for the overall average velocity.

title: Overall average speed
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the overall average speed as 7 m/s using total distance and total time.

title: Segment average speeds
description: Important: Student correctly calculates the average speeds for the A-B segment (8 m/s) and the B-C segment (6 m/s).

title: Velocity vs. speed distinction
description: Important: Student's reasoning or final answers clearly distinguish between vector velocity (with direction) and scalar speed.

title: Correct time usage
description: Important: Student correctly uses the total time (10 s) for overall calculations and the individual segment times (5 s each) for segment calculations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All final answers include correct units (m/s and degrees where applicable).

title: Confusing distance and displacement
description: Pitfall: Student uses total distance (70 m) instead of displacement (50 m) when calculating average velocity.

title: Direction omission for velocity
description: Pitfall: Student states the magnitude of the average velocity but omits its required direction.

title: Incorrect time summation
description: Pitfall: Student uses an incorrect total time (e.g., 5 s) for the overall average speed or velocity calculations.
